channel.description: Latest articles from Best Little Sites (comicbookmovie.com)

item.title: DEATH SPIRAL: Marvel Comics Reveals First Look At Peter Parker, The Amazing Spider-Carnage
item.description: Marvel Comics has shared a first look at Amazing Spider-Man #27, the final chapter in the "Death Spiral" storyline, and it's going feature the debut of Peter Parker as the Amazing Spider-Carnage.

item.title: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY: 5 Biggest Reveals And Spoilers In The Four Teaser Trailers
item.description: With all four Avengers: Doomsday teaser trailers now officially released by Marvel Studios, we're taking a closer look at what they tell us about the Multiverse Saga's penultimate chapter.

item.title: WONDER MAN TV Spot Reveals Why The Department Of Damage Control Is Targeting Simon Williams
item.description: Up until now, it's been hard to say why the DODC would have its sights set on a wannabe A-lister. Well, this new Wonder Man TV spot explains what's put Simon Williams on their radar.

item.title: SPIDER-MAN And DOCTOR STRANGE 2 Director Sam Raimi Reveals His Biggest Criticism Of Today's Superhero Movies
item.description: Promoting his new movie, Send Help, Spider-Man director Sam Raimi has revealed that he has one major issue with today's superhero movies (and it's probably not what you'd expect).

item.title: DC Comics Announces BIZARRO: YEAR NONE, THE FURY OF FIRESTORM, And ZATANNA For April's Next Level Comics
item.description: Bizarro gets an origin story this April in Bizarro: Year None from Kevin Smith. The next wave of DC: Next Level titles will also include Zatanna and The Fury of Firestorm.

item.title: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY Trailers Rack Up Over 1 Billion Combined Views; Joe Russo Teases Steve Rogers' Return
item.description: The four Avengers: Doomsday teaser trailers have racked up over 1 billion online views—not including the leaks—and to go with that news, we have new comments from Joe Russo and Nia DaCosta.

item.title: Glen Powell Addresses Assertions That He's The Next Tom Cruise - "That's A Losing Enterprise"
item.description: After sharing the screen with Tom Cruise in Top Gun: Maverick, many believe Glen Powell is well-positioned to follow a similar path and emerge as Hollywood's next major leading man.

item.title: RETURN TO SILENT HILL Interview: Director Christophe Gans On Adapting The Classic SILENT HILL 2 (Exclusive)
item.description: Return to Silent Hill director Christophe Gans talks to us about adapting Silent Hill 2 for the upcoming movie, bringing Pyramid Head back to theaters, and the importance of practical effects.

item.title: Move Over SOLO LEVELING: The TOMB RAIDER KING Anime Debuts First Trailer
item.description: Find out why Tomb Raider King could be the next big manhwa adaptation, just like Solo Leveling was. Could Seo Joo-Heon rise to the same iconic status as Sung Jin-Woo?
